request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work (law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, company and plant
documents) using ONLY the documents in the current folder, one text file per document; README.md lists them with their rank. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need: search in English and in Italian, follow references from one article or annex to another, and read the whole section before you rely on it.

Rules:
- Use only the files. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- Answer only if a passage states the answer for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the same article
  and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline). A passage about a neighbouring subject does not
  answer the question: then the kind is "unknown" and the value is null. A question about something that happened
  (the date of the last check, whether something is overdue today) is "unknown" unless a passage records that event.
- A passage marked "corrected by the corrigendum" already shows the corrected wording: reason with it. The old
  wording, given in the mark, is no longer valid.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the passages, one by one. A repeal or an
  application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a date is still fully in
  force on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does not yet bind on earlier days.
- When passages of different rank disagree, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's manual,
  then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.) wins over a
  ministerial decree (DM). Say which one wins.
- A row of a table belongs to the thing named in that same row. Read the row of the item asked about, not a
  neighbouring row. When the question itself states a condition ("if it were in regular use", "built in 2017"),
  reason with that condition.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / by which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "how often / for how
  long / within what time" is "duration"; "can / may / is / does / must" is "boolean"; "which / what (several
  things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition is "text" (one short sentence naming every element asked for).
- Point at the evidence: for every passage you rely on, copy word for word the sentence, or the table row, that
  states what you use. Copy exactly, without changing a character; do not join text from two places.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not state it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "what the passages say and how it leads to the answer, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y", "P6M", "P45D", "PT1H" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "evidence": [{"file": "<file name>", "quote": "<copied exactly from that file, one sentence or one table row>"}]}
request.prompt:
Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: The UR5e manual contains a Declaration of Incorporation and the robot's assembly instructions. Once the robot has been incorporated into the robot cell, of which documentation of the final machinery must these two documents become part under Directive 2006/42/EC?

What the fact store already holds on this question (facts taken earlier from these same documents, each with the
sentence it comes from). They are leads, not the answer: a fact can be incomplete, about a neighbouring subject,
or wrong. Check each one you use against the files, and search further whenever they do not settle the question.
The store has no answer of its own.
Facts (subject | relation | value | condition | [document, place]):
- partly completed machinery | must accompany | assembly instructions and the declaration of incorporation | if: until it is incorporated into the final machinery | [DIR, Art. 13(2)] | sentence: "The assembly instructions and the declaration of incorporation shall accompany the partly completed machinery until it is incorporated into the final machinery and shall then form part of the technical file for that machinery."
- Universal Robots e-Series partly completed machine | has declaration | EU Declaration of Incorporation (DOI) (in accordance with 2006/42/EC Annex II B) | [ur5e-manual, p. 220] | sentence: "Declaration of Incorporation (original) EU Declaration of Incorporation (DOI) (in accordance with 2006/42/EC Annex II B) Manufacturer:"

- Universal Robots e-Series partly completed machine | has declaration | relevant technical documentation has been compiled in accordance with Part B of… | [ur5e-manual, p. 220] | sentence: "It is declared that the relevant technical documentation has been compiled in accordance with Part B of Annex VII of the Machinery Directive."
- Universal Robots e-Series | conforms to standard | Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC | [ur5e-manual, p. 220] | sentence: "Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC The following essential requirements have been fulfilled:"
- Universal Robots robots | has declaration | Declaration of Incorporation (DOI) according to the Machinery Directive | [ur10e-manual, p. 229] | sentence: "You can find the Declaration of Incorporation (DOI) according to the Machinery Directive in the chapter:"
- Universal Robots robots | has declaration | Declaration of Incorporation (DOI) according to the Machinery Directive | [ur5e-manual, p. 222] | sentence: "You can find the Declaration of Incorporation (DOI) according to the Machinery Directive in the chapter: Declarations and Certificates."
- partly completed machinery | has obligation | must not be put into service | if: until the final machinery into which it is to be incorporated has been declared in conformity with the provisions of this Directive, where appropriate | [DIR, Annex II, 1] | sentence: "a statement that the partly completed machinery must not be put into service until the final machinery into which it is to be incorporated has been declared in conformity with the provisions of this Directive, where appropriate;"
- manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | shall draw up the EU declaration of incorporation in accordance with Article… | if: Where compliance of partly completed machinery with the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III has been demonstrated in the… | [REG, Art. 11(2)] | sentence: "Where compliance of partly completed machinery with the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III has been demonstrated in the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part B, manufacturers shall draw up the EU declaration of incorporation in accordance with Article 22."
- declaration of incorporation of partly completed machinery | has obligation | must contain the following particulars | [DIR, Annex II, 1] | sentence: "The declaration of incorporation must contain the following particulars:"

- partly completed machinery | must accompany | EU declaration of incorporation set out in Annex V, Part B | if: or, alternatively, manufacturers shall provide the internet address or machine readable code | [REG, Art. 11(8)] | sentence: "Manufacturers shall ensure that the partly completed machinery is accompanied by the EU declaration of incorporation set out in Annex V, Part B or, alternatively, manufacturers shall provide the internet address or machine readable code where that EU declaration of incorporation can be accessed in the assembly instructions set out in Annex XI."
